title: Zita Cobb — Shorefast featured as a case study in Incorruptible
summary: Zita Cobb — Founder/CEO of Shorefast and one of the case-study subjects featured in Incorruptible — publicly endorses the book on LinkedIn. Shorefast's place-based economic development work on Fogo Island is a section in the book itself.
blockquote:
At last! Eric Ries' excellent new book INCORRUPTIBLE is out! This work explores "why good companies go bad, and how great companies stay great."

Spoiler alert: it's about the mission. And "it matters who owns what".

So proud that Shorefast gets a section in it, spreading the word about our work with other communities in generating the type of economic development that creates agency and dignity.

Thank you Eric Ries for including our conversation in the book and for your ongoing support.

INCORRUPTIBLE is already a best-selling business book and an instant classic.
